note: Than Lwin Times, as Burma News International carried it on 27 February 2023, when online booking resumed: 35,000 kyat for a new passport (75,000 for one lost or damaged, written as a replacement route; the kyat equivalent of US$75 for one lost abroad isn't, there being no route abroad); the latest official figure found. sources.title: Burma News International (Than Lwin Times), Myanmar's passport services return with technical hitch (27 February 2023)
sources.said: Online reservation queue for Myanmar passport application was resumed on 24 February, but the system has not fully recovered with some delays. Although the 24-hour booking is allowed on www.passport.gov.mm ... Authorities charged K35,000 for application of new Myanmar passport, K75,000 for a damaged or lost passport. ... K75,000 for a damaged or lost passport.
